build_visual_backbone: build a UniVLGVisualBackbone module with a config and optional backbone freezing
run_visual_backbone_forward: run the forward pass of UniVLGVisualBackbone to get mask and multi-scale features
build_resnet_backbone_custom: build a custom ResNet backbone with multi-scale xyz and p2v inputs
build_pixel_decoder: build a pixel decoder from a backbone output shape for feature pyramid extraction
freeze_backbone_parameters: freeze backbone parameters except panet-related layers during initialization
